titulo: Evacuations issued as multiple wildfires ignite in hot, windy California
cuerpo: Largest blaze the Henderson fire near San Diego as strong winds and severe heat could fuel rapid spread Multiple wildfires ignited across California on Thursday as the state braced for more strong winds and high temperatures that could fuel rapid fire growth over the next several days. The largest blaze, dubbed the Henderson fire, erupted in Camp Pendleton, a San Diego Marine Corps training base, and quickly consumed more than 1,000 acres. Evacuations have been issued and officials briefly closed part of the Interstate 5, a major highway in the region. Continue reading...
